exposure: hospital policy to limit planned caesarean deliveries before 39 weeks of gestation
outcome: Composite adverse neonatal health outcome (respiratory morbidity, 5-minute Apgar score of <7, neonatal intensive care unit admission, mortality)
cohort: Women with a low-risk planned repeat caesarean delivery at British Columbia Women's Hospital, Vancouver, Canada, in the period 2005-2012
finding: The policy had no detectable impact on adverse neonatal outcomes, maternal complications, or healthcare costs, but increased the risk of out-of-hours delivery.
mod_finding: The policy to limit planned caesarean deliveries before 39 weeks of gestation led to an increase in out-of-hours deliveries.
